messages.confirmActivateDistribution: Activate this distribution? Audience contacts will be split across the linked campaigns by their weights and message sending will start.
messages.confirmStopDistribution: Stop this distribution? No new contacts will be enrolled. Contacts already enrolled will still be processed, and the campaigns will complete once they are done.

tooltips.continuous: When enabled, contacts added to the Target Lists after activation are automatically enrolled and split across the campaigns. The distribution stays Active until you stop it. When disabled, the audience is split once at activation and the distribution stops automatically when all campaigns finish.
tooltips.targetLists: The audience of this distribution. Contacts from these lists are split across the linked campaigns by their weights.
tooltips.excludeCampaigns: Contacts already reached (Sent, Delivered, Read, or Replied) by these campaigns are excluded from enrollment.
tooltips.excludingTargetLists: Contacts that are members of these lists are excluded from enrollment.
tooltips.totalEnrolled: Total number of recipients enrolled across all campaigns of this distribution.
